statement: 对任意自然数 n，n + 0 = n

proof_origin.author: G1 worker
proof_origin.note: No paper or external proof source exists for this demonstration; GOAL.md fixes the target. The proof below spells out the defining equation also used by the local core theorem.

proof.text: Fix an arbitrary natural number n. Natural-number addition recurses on its second argument, with defining equation n + 0 = n. Therefore n + 0 reduces to n and the desired equality is reflexivity. Since n was arbitrary, the conclusion holds for every natural number.

edge_cases: n = 0: 0 + 0 reduces to 0, so the equation is 0 = 0.
n = 1: 1 + 0 reduces to 1. The same defining equation applies to any successor and imposes no positivity or upper-bound hypothesis.
